verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs describe real-time multi-party collaboration on a 'document set,' task assignment to co-founders, and audit logging of who changed what (clerky-docs-7, clerky-docs-13, clerky-docs-4), which implies a shared signing workflow, but no evidence explicitly describes an e-signature routing mechanism (e.g., sequential/parallel signer order, signature status tracking) as distinct from general document collaboration. Missing for 10: explicit e-signature terminology, description of routing/ordering logic for multiple signers, and any hands-on account confirming the signature flow works as routed.
